subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Kumusta RECIPIENT_NAME,
Balik sa naunang email ko tungkol sa completed ride ninyo. Mula nang iutos ng DOTr noong Abril 30 na ihinto ang onboarding ng bagong TNVS at motorcycle-taxi driver dahil sa cap violations, lumiit ang supply at ang kalidad ng bawat rider ang naging laban. Sa Southeast Asia, 15 hanggang 40 dolyar ang acquisition cost ng daily-commuter na rider, kaya ang unang biyahe ang nagtatakda ng tunay na cost. Sa kompetisyon kasama ang Grab, ang completed-ride event at holdout namin ang naglilinaw kung gaano net-new ang rider. Worth bang ihambing sa source mix ninyo?
angle: fresh angle: DOTr/LTFRB onboarding halt (Apr 2026, sourced) + SEA rider CAC band $15-40
register_notes: Stage 2 tl ride_hailing UA: native Tagalog; acknowledges 2nd follow-up and references the original email in the first sentence. Fresh angle = timely sourced development (DOTr memo signed Apr 30 2026 ordering LTFRB to halt onboarding of new TNVS/motorcycle-taxi drivers over cap violations, per Manila Times + Inquirer) plus REAL web-verified SEA rider CAC band of $15-40 acquisition vs $300-800 LTV for daily commuters (dojobusiness). Rotates to one peer, Grab, from brand_candidates only. No MobUpps figure this stage (empty illustrative_flags); MobUpps incrementality/holdout cited without a number. Exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no curly quotes; no hedge before any number; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
